CustomField.description: Red marker when the vehicle the customer wants has no cars available, so the rep requests an import.
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISBLANK(Vehicle_Model_Of_Interest__c), IsConverted), "", IF(Vehicle_Model_Of_Interest__r.Available_Stock__c = 0, IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_red.gif", "") & " Sold out - an import will be needed", IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_green.gif", "") & " In stock: " & Vehicle_Model_Of_Interest__r.Stock_Status__c))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Whether the vehicle can be sold now. Green: available or reserved. Red: sold out or sold to someone else.
CustomField.label: AM Availability
